request.question: In plain words, how is the rate of change on this chart worked out?

blocks.text: The app compares every pair of years, calculating how much the yearly values changed between them, then takes the median of those pairwise rates. It uses the actual calendar years, so a missing year is not treated as if the remaining years were consecutive.
The chart reports this rate on a per-decade basis; it describes the record but is not, by itself, evidence of a trend.
